prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was reminiscing about that Beijing trip in 2025—funny how I kept bouncing between different hotel options back then.
We ended up staying at the Beijing Hotel, just because it was easiest after a long day of meetings.
The check-in was 2025-03-15, and it was literally just 1 night—super quick stop.
And yeah, the reservation was under Liu Yang—my coworker handled it and I just showed up.
Later that month I was in Chengdu and people kept talking about attractions there—Kuanzhai Alley especially; my friend Li Na had already booked a 10:00 slot for 2025-03-24 for just 1 ticket.
